scripts.bundle:openapi:admin: REDOCLY_SUPPRESS_UPDATE_NOTICE=true redocly bundle docs/openapi.yaml --overlay docs/overlays/admin.yaml --output docs/dist/openapi.admin.yaml
scripts.bundle:openapi:ja: REDOCLY_SUPPRESS_UPDATE_NOTICE=true redocly bundle docs/openapi.yaml --overlay docs/overlays/ja.yaml --output docs/dist/openapi.ja.yaml
scripts.bundle:openapi: npm run bundle:openapi:public && npm run bundle:openapi:admin && npm run bundle:openapi:ja
scripts.build:docs: npm run bundle:openapi && npm run build:docs:public && npm run build:docs:admin && npm run build:docs:ja
scripts.generate:diagrams: node scripts/generate-workflow-diagrams.mjs && npm run generate:asyncapi-diagrams && npm run generate:dmn-diagrams
scripts.check:diagrams: npm run test:diagrams && node scripts/generate-workflow-diagrams.mjs --check && node scripts/generate-asyncapi-diagrams.mjs --check && node scripts/generate-dmn-diagrams.mjs --check
scripts.lint:arazzo: REDOCLY_SUPPRESS_UPDATE_NOTICE=true redocly lint docs/workflows/*.arazzo.yaml && npm run check:diagrams && node scripts/check-arazzo-coverage.mjs
scripts.lint:openapi:check: npm run lint:redocly && npm run check:diagrams && node scripts/check-arazzo-coverage.mjs && npm run lint:dmn
scripts.lint:openapi: npm run bundle:openapi && npm run lint:openapi:check
